steps.content: Bang!
Hella knocks an enemy to the ground with a steel water pipe.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Why are y'all looking so sulky? Shouldn't you be happy that I got rid of another one?
Nine minutes into the battle, one-third of the team has already been wounded.
If it weren't for the complex terrain of the trailer park, the enemy's absolute advantage in numbers would have wiped out your entire team in those few minutes.
Even so, tasked with protecting Horo and two other seriously wounded teammates, the situation is becoming worse for you.
Under the circumstances, it's almost impossible to evacuate everyone safely.

options: Stay behind to hold back the enemy

choices.text: Stay behind to hold back the enemy

steps.content: Hecate.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Yes.
You and Team B escort Horo and the wounded westward. Avoid the spies as much as possible and take them back to the Legion's stronghold.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: What about me?
We'll stay and feint to the east.
We'll make as big of a distraction as possible to cover their retreat.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hahaha, I knew it! No one can handle a suicide mission better than the two of us!

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: No!
Horo's voice isn't all that loud, but very firm.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Why, you wanna stay? In this pathetic state? No thanks. I don't want no burden dragging me down when I fight!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Listen to the Chief now, you lil' bitty.
Hella approaches Horo with a smug look on her face. Though she calls her "lil' bitty," the two are actually around the same height.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: No true Legionnaire ever flees without a fight.
Horo does not snap back at Hella. Instead, her calm words win the approval of the Legionnaires around her.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: Plus, I can't watch others die for me anymore.
Feeling awkward, Hella takes a step back and mutters to herself.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: What a poser...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I can protect this buddy by myself. Besides, you didn't even bring any weapons. What are you going to fight with?

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: My Sinner powers don't need weapons.
The battle mark on Horo's body starts to glow through the bandages.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: And don't forget, this is a trailer park, and I am a daughter of the Convoy.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: There are enough parts here for me to use.
After saying all this, both Horo and Hella look towards you.
Time is running out and a decision must be made as soon as possible.
I understand...
Then let's break through the siege together.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Pfft.
Hella snorts in dissatisfaction, but stops objecting. She hoists her water pipe over one shoulder.
This plan is too idealistic. Your chances of breaking through the siege are slim.
Yet by now, you notice that everyone is already clenching their weapons tightly.
The cloud of gloom and uncertainty has disappeared from their faces.
A bullet whizzes by and pierces Hella's forearm.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hecate!
The Nightmare tears apart the incoming enemy, creating a space for Hella to stand.
Hella leaps forward, swinging the steel pipe in her hand.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Had enough fun? My turn!
Bang!
The enemies before her collapse in one swoop. The battle pauses temporarily.

steps.speaker: Public Security Bureau Commander
steps.content: Imbeciles! ******* losing even with ******* Mania weapons in your hands!

steps.speaker: Public Security Bureau henchman
steps.content: S-sir, what are we gonna do now?

steps.speaker: Public Security Bureau Commander
steps.content: We can't wait anymore. Their reinforcements are probably arriving.

steps.speaker: Public Security Bureau Commander
steps.content: Set fire and smoke them out!

steps.speaker: Public Security Bureau henchman
steps.content: But... but Sir...

steps.speaker: Public Security Bureau Commander
steps.content: Shut the **** up and do it!

steps.speaker: Public Security Bureau Commander
steps.content: Set the fire and we get discharged at most. But if we let them escape, we're all totally f****** damned! Do you understand?!

steps.speaker: Public Security Bureau henchman
steps.content: Un...understood.
Molotov cocktails strike the trailer one after another. Feeding on the piles of garbage, the fire grows bigger and bigger.
The head of the group grabs a nearby henchman's Mania weapon and aims at the only escape route.

steps.speaker: Public Security Bureau Commander
steps.content: The wind is in the right direction. The gods are on my side! I'm not going to lose to you **** dumba**es!
Scattered footsteps get closer and closer. The commander's face flushes with excitement, his teeth grinding in relish.

steps.speaker: Public Security Bureau Commander
steps.content: Prepare to die, you f***ers!

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: You're the one who's going to die.
The voice from above leaves him momentarily stunned.
A petite girl wielding a particularly large weapon stands atop the trailer.
The next instant, she leaps down and hacks the hideous Mania weapon to pieces with her ax. The man carrying the weapon is flung a few meters into the distance.
After rolling over a dozen times on the ground, the man twitches before losing consciousness.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: Attack!
As Horo roars, all the Sinners, mission operatives, and Legionnaires surge at once to repel the now leaderless Public Security Bureau forces.
In the chaos, you grab a kneeling Horo and carry her out of the encirclement.
You sprint for a long time and finally completely rid yourselves of the enemies after you.
The raging fire exacerbated the chaos. The Public Security Bureau forces are no longer a threat.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: What a pity... I had wanted to go back again someday.
You gasp for breath as you keep running with Horo on your back. Though she is light, you are still exhausted.
Maybe it's time to exercise more.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief, the coast is clear. Please stay where you are. A convoy will pick you up soon.
It begins to rain. Gazing at the Legion stronghold nearby, you realize the time to part ways has come.
No... it's impossible! I refuse to believe that the captain would accept such an operation!

steps.speaker: Jer
steps.content: Lenny is seriously injured. We have to bring him back quickly and make preparations for the next round of attacks from the Public Security Bureau.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: What's there to be scared of? They won't be around much longer.
Hearing Hella's and the Legionnaire's voices, Horo stirs on your shoulders.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: ${PlayerName}, let me down.
Don't move around. It's gonna tear your wound even more.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: I'm fine.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Fine my butt!
Horo doesn't bother to bicker with Hella, but she insists that you put her down. You finally relent.
After all, she has to say goodbye to her fellow Legionnaires. It'll be a long time until they can meet again.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: Jer... Lenny... Danny... Kevin...

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: Black-Haired Woman

steps.speaker: Jer
steps.content: Thanks to you... and this Chief, we all survived.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: When this is all over, you won't have to fight anymore.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: After all, Syndicate's gangs are gone, so there's nothing left to conquer.

steps.speaker: Jer
steps.content: Yeah. All we have to do is holding on to what we have.

steps.speaker: Jer
steps.content: We used to be the Convoy back in the day anyways. If there aren't any gangs to fight, we can work in logistics again. We won't starve.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: Good... I no longer want to see...
As Horo lets out a sigh of relief, her feet go limp, making her almost fall to the ground.
You grab her just in time.
Jer looks at both of you with mixed feelings in his eyes.

steps.speaker: Jer
steps.content: Sigh... At first, we were just carrying out Zoya's orders to protect Horo.

steps.speaker: Jer
steps.content: She's always a little girl in our eyes.

steps.speaker: Jer
steps.content: It's only natural for adults to protect kids.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: I told you, I'm not a kid anymore.

steps.speaker: Jer
steps.content: You're right. You're not.
Jer's voice sounds totally sincere.

steps.speaker: Jer
steps.content: Zoya was right. You are the one who shall take up her torch.

steps.speaker: Jer
steps.content: You are fit to be the Legion's leader.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: I'm... not really a leader.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: Boss Zoya will come back someday. She has been and will be the only leader of the Legion.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: However, before she returns, Chief ${PlayerName} and I won't sit idly by if the Legion runs into any trouble.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: Right?
Horo looks toward you.
Um-hmm.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Quit pretending to be tough, you lil' bitty. It's really comical to throw around such big talk when you're coughing up blood, ya know?
The rumble of the convoy steadily approaches. It's time to bid farewell.
The rain gradually extinguishes the fire behind you.
On the way back, your comms device rings. A familiar name flashes on the screen.

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: Hey there, newbie. Great job this time.
Langley seems to already know everything that happened.
What do you need me to do?

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: Keep going ahead and stop at the third intersection.

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: My people will be waiting there. Give them what you found.
With that, Langley hangs up.
At the third intersection, a man in a gray hat is waiting under an umbrella.
After taking the files, he flashes a polite smile and tips his hat to you.
You guys were nearby this whole time?

steps.speaker: 9th Agency Personnel
steps.content: Yes.

steps.speaker: 9th Agency Personnel
steps.content: I know what you're trying to say, honorable Chief.

steps.speaker: 9th Agency Personnel
steps.content: But it's probably not the best idea for us two mere intelligence agents to battle the vicious Public Security Bureau forces.
The people from the 9th Agency are as repulsively cunning as always.

steps.speaker: 9th Agency Personnel
steps.content: But don't worry, the Public Security Bureau will soon cease to exist.

steps.speaker: 9th Agency Personnel
steps.content: As long as your Legion friends survive today, no one will threaten them anymore.
The engine rumbles, and the man waves to you.
To your other side, Horo is already fast asleep. Though she is seriously injured, a smile lingers on her face.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: Earl...
You gently stroke Horo's forehead, wiping the tears from her eyes.
Hope she has a sweet dream.
